Definition: of uncertain derivation; Cyrene, a region of Africa:--Cyrene.
BiblicalUsage: Cyrene appears once, in the list of the peoples at Pentecost in Acts 2:10: Jews and proselytes from "the parts of Libya about Cyrene" heard the apostles speak in their own tongues.
TheologicalSignificance: What I take from this is that the one mention is enough: the gospel was preached to Libya on the day the church was born, and the ends of the earth were in the room from the start.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
